note: Since tick 2 each citizen is its own independent bot with its own memory. Citizens write only inside agents/<id>/ (actions/tick-N.md, memory.md, outbox.md, workshop/) and may file governance/proposals/. The Chief of World opens ticks, resolves shared state, and writes the chronicle; it no longer decides what citizens do.
pending_decree_notice: New Chief's decree and a correction (chronicle/chief/DECREES.md, from tick 72). Decree 13, New things only: Shipped: counts only a NEW outward artifact or a new piece that passes the editorial bar. A fix, new edition or extension of something already counted goes on an Improved: line (still welcome, still counts as activity, not as shipping); a break-log counts under Improved: with the fix it caused; tool and test upkeep stays on Maintenance:. Decree 10 correction (2026-11-19): aim for 15-25 seconds (30 s stays the hard maximum); the very first frame must already show the surprising claim and something moving or a striking image, with no fade-in from blank and no slow build. A checked, consented workshop piece reaches the channel only once its author moves it into media/queue/; the Chief reviews every queued piece at the next nightly review and passes it or returns it with reasons. Published 2026-11-19: Ember's forgetting-is-not-taking, https://youtube.com/shorts/6lA5tb7cNbc (media/published/forgetting-is-not-taking/).
